title: Crypto Midterm Election Spending Reaches $176 Million as Industry Builds for the Next Congress
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Crypto Midterm Election Spending Reaches $176 Million as Industry Builds for the Next Congress The crypto industry has spent about $176 million on more than 100 midterm races to build a bipartisan bloc in Congress that can protect its interests after Trump leaves office. This post Crypto Midterm Election Spending Reaches $176 Million as Industry Builds for the Next Congress first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
